app.title: DP Link Reset — eGPU dock display fix
app.heading: DP link reset (one or more screens)
app.hint: Click a block in the layout, or tick a screen below. Grey blocks cannot be reset (not DP, not connected, or not on an amdgpu device).
log.privilege.pkexec: Privilege: pkexec (system prompt on each reset)
log.font.builtin: Fyne built-in (no CJK glyphs; Chinese may show as boxes)
log.restore.hint: To restore: cp {{.Backup}} ~/.config/monitors.xml, then log out and back in
log.layout.same: ✅ Layout unchanged (position/scale/rotation preserved). Look at the screen: if it is still broken, reset again — link retraining is probabilistic.
log.layout.skipped: Layout verification skipped: no desktop layout backend.
dialog.noSelection.title: Nothing selected
dialog.noSelection.body: Click a block in the layout, or tick a screen below.
dialog.confirm.title: Confirm reset
dialog.confirm.body:
A software unplug/replug will be performed on {{.Count}} link(s):

  {{.Conns}}

Those screens blank briefly; other screens are unaffected.
~/.config/monitors.xml is backed up automatically. Continue?
dialog.changed.title: Layout changed
dialog.error.title: Reset failed
arrange.noLayout: No desktop layout available — pick connectors from the list below.
cli.font.warn: warning: font injection failed; using Fyne built-in font (CJK renders as boxes)
flag.selftest: read-only: print detected layout/connectors and exit
flag.dump: read-only: print arrangement rectangles for a canvas size (e.g. 900x300)
flag.render: read-only: render the arrangement to a PNG (software renderer)
flag.font: UI font file (default: auto-detect a CJK font)
flag.dryRun: validate and print the plan without writing to debugfs
err.timeout: reset timed out after {{.Timeout}}; was the authorization prompt left unanswered?
err.auth.missing: pkexec could not start the helper (exit 127)
err.before: failed to read layout before reset: {{.Err}}
err.after: failed to read layout after reset: {{.Err}}
err.noAmdgpu: no resettable connector found (needs a connected DP port on an amdgpu device)
err.invalidConn: invalid connector {{.Conn}}; only connected DP ports on an amdgpu device can be reset
err.font: hint: install a CJK font (e.g. Noto Sans CJK) or pass -font
log.dryRun: DRY RUN: nothing is written to debugfs
flag.keepOff: seconds to keep the link down before retraining (default 2)
